einzeiler: Josip Broz Tito built a unique socialist state and held Yugoslavia together for decades.
kurzfassung: Josip Broz Tito founded the Non-Aligned Movement and pioneered a hybrid market-socialism model that brought unprecedented prosperity and freedom of travel to Yugoslavia. However, the state's stability depended entirely on his personal charisma, leading to severe economic inequality and resurging ethnic nationalism after his death. Following his passing in 1980, the artificial federation unraveled, culminating in devastating ethnic conflicts in the 1990s.
stichpunkte: Tito co-founded the Non-Aligned Movement in 1956, positioning Yugoslavia between the capitalist West and the Soviet bloc.
Yugoslavia adopted a hybrid economic model combining state-controlled heavy industry with self-managed workers' councils and private enterprise.
Citizens enjoyed high living standards, cultural exports, world-class sports achievements, and unmatched freedom to travel abroad.
Tito cultivated relationships with global leaders and celebrities while maintaining absolute political control through state security.
Economic imbalances between wealthier northern republics and poorer southern regions fueled growing regional resentment.
The 1974 constitution introduced a rotating presidency designed to prevent any single republic from dominating the post-Tito era.
Tito's death in 1980 triggered widespread national grief, marked by one of the largest state funerals in history.
Without Tito's unifying authority, deep-seated ethnic tensions resurfaced, leading to the bloody breakup of Yugoslavia in the 1990s.

clips.hook: From 25 member states to 110 in the mid-70s
clips.text: The coalition expanded dramatically over the decades, capturing the imagination of populations seeking to avoid nuclear annihilation and superpower dominance.

clips.hook: None of their demands are actually met
clips.text: While clever political maneuvering made the leader appear aligned with youthful protesters, the movement's ringleaders were quietly imprisoned and silenced.

beschreibung:
Tito becomes an international celebrity, with a jet-set lifestyle to match his status. His hybrid ‘coca-cola socialism’ sees Yugoslavia booming. But the good times have been built on shaky foundations. And as Tito ails it seems his Balkan miracle will prove short-lived…
